definition: Same-sponsor pairs of NSCLC trials (is_lung = 1, industry lead sponsor, any phase; trials CT.gov lists as withdrawn or not yet recruiting at the snapshot excluded) whose enrollment windows are both open on some date between 2015-01-01 and the registry snapshot (2026-10-16), that share >= 10 identifiable registered sites (worldwide; site rows withdrawn from the trial and anonymized per-city pseudo-sites excluded), and whose eligibility overlap on the synthetic population is >= 0.8 in at least one direction (o_PQ = share of P's eligible patients also eligible for Q: one population nearly contained in the other). Window: start to start + 0.65 x (primary completion - start), bounded by the CT.gov status at the snapshot (still recruiting = open through the snapshot; any other status = closed by the snapshot), so nothing is projected past the snapshot. Excluded and counted separately: pairs where either trial has no encoded criteria (an empty criteria list describes everyone and passes the overlap test trivially) and pairs where either trial has a closed status and registers no completion date at all (no window can be estimated).

headline.text: 21 same-sponsor pairs where both trials' eligibility was hand-encoded and reviewed; in 19 of them at least one trial has a restriction the synthetic population cannot represent, so their overlap is a ceiling (2 without that flag). The broad count (134) adds 113 pairs that rest on the unreviewed rule-based parse for at least one trial (the parse never sets the upper-bound flag, so those pairs are unflagged, not verified); 21 of all 134 are 'contained' in a trial with 2 or fewer encoded criteria. Lead with 21 and cite 134 only with these caveats.

both_hand_encoded.definition: both trials' criteria hand-encoded and reviewed (compiler.overrides)

container_min_3_criteria.definition: the containing trial (Q when o_PQ >= 0.8) has >= 3 encoded criteria, so containment is not automatic

container_at_most_2_criteria.definition: the containing trial has <= 2 encoded criteria: most synthetic patients pass it, so containment at >= 0.8 is close to automatic

notes: Descriptive: counts of registered sites, enrollment windows bounded by the registry status, and synthetic-population eligibility shares. Nothing here predicts enrollment speed, and no window runs past the snapshot.

Lead with headline.count (both trials hand-encoded and reviewed). The broad count includes pairs that rest on the unreviewed rule-based parse; a parse that keeps only one or two criteria (e.g. 'ECOG 0-1' or 'Stage IV') admits most patients, so a population 'contained' in it says little (see robustness).

upper_bound: either trial's hand-encoded design entry lists a required biomarker the population does not model, a basket or multi-cohort design, or any unmodeled restriction; the overlap shown is then a ceiling on the modeled populations, not a measurement.
Overlap months are the full overlap of the two bounded windows up to the snapshot (not only the part after the cut-off date).
Site lists are as registered on ClinicalTrials.gov at the snapshot; a site's activation dates are not public.

The count is a floor: sponsors that register their sites anonymously ('Research Site'; see context.considered_trials_with_mostly_anonymized_sites) cannot show identifiable shared sites, and different lead-sponsor strings of one company are not merged.
